failures.evidence: Real binaries at the merged head. A nats-server user 'listener' has publish denied on notifications.agent.ses_denied6, and ses_denied6 holds role t6-denied. POST /v1/messages/publish {topic: notifications.role.t6-denied} -> 403 {"error":"envoy: the message bus denied the publish under this listener's own permissions: … Permissions Violation for Publish to \"notifications.agent.ses_denied6\""}, with no reason field, in 42 ms. envoy-client publish -> EnvoyApiError 403 in 82 ms with no retry: final. The daemon's notify.HTTPPublisher (throwaway test against the same binary, deleted) -> a plain error, neither ErrNoHolder, ErrNotDelivered nor ErrRefusedByHolder. That error makes outbox.notice return a failure (outbox.go:713-714), so the row is retried on its backoff without a cap, and earlierNoticeFor (outbox.go:691) holds every later notice to that architect behind it until an operator changes the grant. mergeQueue (outbox.go:747-748) retries such a packet forever too, where a 403 capability posts a Dispatch message and finishes.
